lead: Use to run work in parallel from a kanban board the person and the agents share: putting work on the board, a goal or a sprint built by subagents (or child sessions when asked), starting, working, or reviewing a card, and locking a port or another resource one session can hold.

orchestrate.cue: run several tasks or a sprint in parallel, resume a round

board.cue: file out-of-scope work, read or move cards, owe a check

dispatch.cue: start an approved card: a subagent, or a session if asked

work-card.cue: this session was started to build one card

review-card.cue: a child reports its card in review: check, land, close

sync-cards.cue: the board drifted from the work

locks.cue: a port, simulator, GPU, or database one session may hold

coordinate.cue: a heavy job or timing run on a machine agents share
